{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/mempool_args.cpp and test/functional/mempool_cluster.py to disallow negating cluster limits and validate minimum limits at startup.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Validates cluster limits at startup to fix an issue where \"-nolimitclustercount passed the upper bound check and triggered an assertion in TxGraph when mempool sanity checks are enabled\" and \"-limitclustersize=0 or -nolimitclustersize made every transaction fail with a misleading error\"."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-cli.cpp minimally and addresses -norpcpassword parsing, but does not alter RPC interfaces, methods, or server handling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Not a member; adjustments to bitcoin-cli and RPC password negation are incidental to the general argument parsing overhaul."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies core argument parsing in src/common/args.cpp and startup handling in src/init.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes hazardous behaviors across startup options where negation evaluated strings to \"0\", causing `-noblocksdir` to write blocks to the working directory, `-notorcontrol` to connect to 0.0.0.0:9051, and notify options to execute a binary named \"0\"."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/wallet/walletutil.cpp, init.cpp, and load.cpp solely to align -walletdir handling with general negated and empty argument rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a member; wallet changes are minor follow-throughs of global argument negation behavior rather than wallet functionality fixes."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
